title: Trancriptome patterns in dermal schwann cells in neuropathic itch and pain
summary: Neuropathic itch can lead to considerable impairment of quality of life. The underlying mechanisms have not yet been extensively explained. The clinical trial is intended to contribute to this clarification. Patients in this study will be examined to better understand the mechanisms. Patients with neuropathic pain and itch will be prospectively recruited and clinically characterised in detail. In the process, group-specific characteristics are to be identified, which should enable better characterisation and therapy in the future.

interventions.name: Peripheral neuropathy (PNP): Patients with different PNP aetiologies: multimodal investigation
Brachioradial pruritus (BRP): patients with brachioradial pruritus (comparison group): multimodal investigation

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
For screening:
Diagnosis of peripheral neuropathy

For participation in the other parts of the study:
Diagnosis of peripheral neuropathy OR diagnosis of brachioradial pruritus OR healthy control subject.

Additional inclusion criterion for peripheral neuropathy:
In the diary over one week, moderate pain ≥ NRS 5 and, pruritus ≤ 1 OR moderate pruritus ≥ 5, pain ≤ 1.
Exclusion criteria:
Other serious illness that would falsify the examination results or make participation difficult, known wound healing disorders or anticoagulation (due to skin biopsy).
